visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short, reddish-brown hair and bangs is outdoors in front of a modern glass-walled building. She wears a black cropped t-shirt and dark blue jeans, adjusting her black-framed glasses with a smile. The lighting is bright and natural. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a GU retail store. The woman is now wearing a white t-shirt and light blue wide-leg jeans, examining white hoodies on a rack labeled 'NEW ARRIVAL'. (3) Back outdoors, she wears a white halter-neck top and dark cargo pants, walking energetically towards the camera with a cheerful expression. (4) Inside the store again, she walks past mannequins dressed in casual attire. The store is well-lit with clean, white shelving and racks of clothing. (5) Outdoors, she gestures with her hands while a digital yellow graphic of a GU discount coupon with a barcode and images of dresses overlays the screen. (6) At the store's checkout counter, she holds her smartphone displaying the barcode and a green passport. A close-up shows a tablet scanning the barcode on her phone screen. (7) She showcases various clothing items inside the store, including a white ribbed top on a hanger. (8) Returning to the outdoor setting, she models three different outfits: first, the black t-shirt with dark 'barrel leg' jeans, emphasizing the high-waisted fit and silhouette. (9) Second, she models the white halter-neck top with dark cargo pants, gesturing to the built-in bra pads of the top. (10) Third, she wears a white t-shirt from the 'OMIYAGE' series featuring a small 'Maneki-neko' (lucky cat) graphic on the chest, pointing at the design. (11) The video ends with her outdoors giving two thumbs up and waving, while the discount coupon graphic reappears on screen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional guide and shopping hack for tourists visiting GU stores in Japan. It hooks viewers with a 'money-saving secret,' explains the coupon/passport requirement for a tax-free discount, and then provides value by showcasing specific recommended apparel items through three different outfit stylings.
